name: Bristol Winter Beginners 2024

venue.name: [Anson Rooms](https://www.bristolsu.org.uk/about-us/venues-and-shops/the-anson-rooms)
venue.address: Anson Rooms, Richmond Building, University of Bristol, 105 Queens Rd, Bristol, BS8 1LN

information: This competition is targeted at **first-time competitors and less experienced competitors**, but everyone is welcome. Please note that while this competition is open to anyone to attend, **only competitors who have attended 2 or fewer competitions before will be eligible for medals**. PLEASE NOTE: This is a Series Competition with [Bristol Winter Open 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BristolWinterOpen2024). You may only attend ONE of these competitions. Please see further details on the [Series Competition tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BristolWinterBeginners2024#43805-series-competition). Please make sure to read all the information in the **FAQ** and the **Important Information** tabs before registering. **Spectators may attend for free!** [![UKCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb0I0IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--1c7aaa67674e675ba6f477cf783142702a671457/UKCA_Logo.png)](https://www.ukca.org/) [![Speedcubing.org](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBa0Z0IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--ce316f12e822c022ffd1c75d1bdee86c94ccbc2d/image.png)](https://speedcubing.org/)
